args.title: Reset orphaned running import jobs stranded by process restarts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/queue.ts

Reset orphaned `running` import jobs (and their uploads) on startup or via worker recovery so that jobs left stranded by a redeploy or process crash do not remain stuck in `running` indefinitely.
